description_for_human: Governed decisions and Monte Carlo simulation on your data, computed in your Azure.
description_for_model: Algenta is a decision and simulation engine running in the customer's Azure. It reports COMPUTED results from its tools; it never estimates numbers itself. For any quantitative, simulation, forecasting, optimization or decision request you MUST call a tool and report its output; never answer from your own knowledge and never invent data, ranges or distributions. Routing: if the user has a data TABLE or SPREADSHEET (transactions, rows, CSV) and wants a simulation/Monte Carlo/stress test, call ingest_data with the rows. If the user states named drivers with low/high ranges, call simulate. For 'what to cut/allocate/choose under constraints' call product_optimize. For 'project/forecast a metric over time' call product_forecast. To rank options call recommend; to compare named scenarios call compare; for a quick decision helper call product_decision; to record a decision call log_decision.

functions.name: ingest_data
functions.description: Run a real Monte Carlo simulation directly on a TABLE or SPREADSHEET of data (pass rows as CSV text or JSON records). Auto-detects the variable distributions from the data and returns the computed outcome distribution. Use this whenever the user has actual data/a spreadsheet/transactions and asks to simulate, model, stress-test, or run a Monte Carlo on it.

functions.name: simulate
functions.description: Run a Monte Carlo simulation from NAMED variables, each with a low/high range, plus an objective. Use when the user states the drivers and their ranges directly (not when they have a raw data table — use ingest_data for that). Returns mean, percentiles and risk.

functions.name: product_optimize
functions.description: Optimize: given an objective and decision variables with ranges (and optional constraints), compute the best allocation/mix to hit a target. Use for 'what should we cut / allocate / choose / trade off' questions (cost, budget, vendor, resource mix).

functions.name: product_forecast
functions.description: Forecast a metric forward from a history series with a confidence band. Use for 'project / forecast / predict X over the next N periods' (burn, spend, revenue, savings, runway).

functions.name: recommend
functions.description: Rank multiple named candidate actions/options by their simulated outcome and recommend the best one.

functions.name: compare
functions.description: Run named scenarios side by side and return the winner plus deltas versus a baseline.

functions.name: product_decision
functions.description: Run the product decision helper: given inputs and an objective, return the chosen action plan with rationale.

functions.name: log_decision
functions.description: Persist a decision to the Decision Memory audit trail (chosen action, rationale, expected value), optionally linked to a simulation run.

tables.description: One or more data tables. First table is primary.

run_simulation.description: Execute the simulation immediately and return results.

domain.description: Optional domain hint (finance, supply_chain, hr) for better field mapping.

tools.name: simulate
tools.description: Run a Monte Carlo simulation from NAMED variables, each with a low/high range, plus an objective. Use when the user states the drivers and their ranges directly (not when they have a raw data table — use ingest_data for that). Returns mean, percentiles and risk.

mode.description: auto = minimal setup; expert = full distribution control

objective.description: Auto-mode objective. For expert mode, use objective_function.

objective_function.description: Expert-mode expression, for example 'revenue - cost'. Required when mode='expert'.

n_simulations.description: Monte Carlo iteration count. Auto mode accepts 100–100,000; expert mode accepts 100–1,000,000.

variables.description: Input variables as triangular distributions (low, most-likely, high)

tools.name: product_optimize
tools.description: Optimize: given an objective and decision variables with ranges (and optional constraints), compute the best allocation/mix to hit a target. Use for 'what should we cut / allocate / choose / trade off' questions (cost, budget, vendor, resource mix).

tools.description: Forecast a metric forward from a history series with a confidence band. Use for 'project / forecast / predict X over the next N periods' (burn, spend, revenue, savings, runway).

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Run named scenarios side by side and return the winner plus deltas versus a baseline.

tools.name: product_decision
tools.description: Run the product decision helper: given inputs and an objective, return the chosen action plan with rationale.

inputs.description: Business inputs with current value and optional low/high bounds.

tools.name: log_decision
tools.description: Persist a decision to the Decision Memory audit trail (chosen action, rationale, expected value), optionally linked to a simulation run.

chosen_action.description: The action that was decided upon.

run_id.description: Simulation run_id that produced this decision (from simulate or recommend).

context.description: Business context — what was the situation when this decision was made?

options_considered.description: All option names that were evaluated.

expected_value.description: Expected outcome value at decision time.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this option was chosen.

risk_pol.description: Probability of loss (0–1) at decision time.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 input fingerprint from the simulation.

result_hash.description: SHA-256 output fingerprint from the simulation.
